subject: SelfCLR-LLP status: repro done, bag-size sensitivity risk
body:
Hi both,

Repro milestone hit May 28. SelfCLR-LLP beats DLLP on both datasets in our runs - on Criteo we see a ~2.1% AUC lift over DLLP and we land within 1.5% of the fully supervised upper bound; MovieLens-1M is tighter but still positive. Farah's preprocessing pipeline is deterministic now, same splits every run.

Risk for the June sweep: bag-size sensitivity. The public benchmarks use fairly small bags, but the customer scenarios we care about have bags of 500-1000 instances, and in a quick pilot the contrastive representation quality degrades noticeably past bag size ~256. I've added a bag-size axis to the sweep grid, which is exactly why we need every one of those 512 H100s for the full five days.

If large-bag results are weak, the honest product story becomes "strong up to bag size 256," and we should decide before the July memo how to frame that.

Efe
